Use this channel from the original input to mix the output with the original input.
If the mask input is connected, use this channel from it to mix the output with the original input.
Dissolve between the original image at 0 and the full effect at 1.

outgray
After all other operations are done, the CIE XYZ space is skewed to the output graypoint so a fully desaturated images is tinted this color.

saturation
The X and Z are multiplied by the overall saturation value.
Image is divided by this channel before being processed, and multiplied again afterwards. This can improve color corrections of anti-aliased edges.

description.plain_text: Transforms the image's colorspace. This operator works by transforming the image colors to CIE XYZ space and then doing simple scales and rotates on the space. In XYZ space the X and Z control the color and the Y is the brightness.
